about.en: University preparation (P28, C4.6) for s2 and adult readers: a checklist she ticks on her phone (checklist.json) and link cards to free courses and scholarships (links.json), each checked by a person on a date and hidden six months later. No lessons, no promises, nothing copied. Every card and the checklist need an adviser and the Dari and Pashto readers before release; the Dari and Pashto text is a draft for native speakers.
